create_commit_scheduler: create a CommitScheduler to upload a local folder to the Hugging Face Hub at regular intervals
run_commit_scheduler_trigger: run a manual commit trigger on the CommitScheduler to push changes to the Hub immediately
build_commit_scheduler_context_manager: build a CommitScheduler as a context manager to auto-commit on exit and stop the scheduler cleanly
test_commit_scheduler_push_to_hub: test the CommitScheduler push_to_hub method to upload changed files to the Hub
review_commit_scheduler_stop: review the CommitScheduler stop method to halt the background scheduler thread
